diagnostics.message: The local-exec provisioner of `null_resource.update_app` registers the GitHub App webhook against `var.webhook_endpoint`, but that endpoint is only functional once the API Gateway route (and its integration/stage deployment) exists. The resource's dependency chain (via `module.runners:output.webhook`) covers only the API, lambda, log group and role — `output.endpoint_relative_path` is a plain local string — so Terraform can run `update-app.sh` before `aws_apigatewayv2_route.webhook` is created, leaving the newly registered webhook pointing at a non-existent route. Add `depends_on` so the app update runs after the webhook route (and integration) are in place.
